setup: echo 'models env ready — uv is not installed in this image, so use .venv/bin/pip or `python3 -m pip install --user uv` for a uv-based subproject'

branchName.instructions: Branch names come from the Kaneo card: MOD-<number>, e.g. MOD-12. Base is main and the PR targets main.

commitMessage.instructions: Imperative subject under 72 characters, naming the pipeline the change touches (translation, speech-recognition, text-to-speech, object-character-recognition). Never commit model binaries, bundles, downloaded corpora or credentials; those belong in storage, not git.

pullRequest.instructions: Open against main. Body: which pipeline and which language pack the change affects, how it was verified (pack-acceptance / pack-sweep output or the exact command run), expected artifact or bundle size changes, and anything left unverified.
